summary:
OMNIVOICE V2.15 — DISTILLATION FEASIBILITY & TEACHER–STUDENT EXPERIMENT DESIGN REPORT
Comprehensive architectural analysis of OmniVoice discrete masked generative modeling, distillation methodologies (Progressive Unmasking, Confidence Distillation), 3 student model designs, dataset licensing (VIVOS, viVoice), resource estimates, and phased experimental proof-of-concept roadmap.
